blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generating realistic human-object interactions (HOI) in complex 3D scenes requires two complementary capabilities: reasoning about interaction feasibility in the environment and synthesizing realistic human-object motion. However, supervision for these capabilities is rarely available jointly at scale. Human-scene datasets provide rich information about environment-aware motion, while human-object datasets capture detailed interaction dynamics, yet paired human-object-scene data remain scarce. We present MAMHOI, an affordance-mediated factorization for scene-aware human-object interaction generation. MAMHOI factorizes scene-aware HOI generation through an explicit motion-affordance interface between scene understanding and motion synthesis: a scene-conditioned model first predicts where and how an interaction can be feasibly executed, and an affordance-conditioned HOI model then generates the corresponding human-object motion. This factorization allows scene understanding and interaction dynamics to be learned from complementary sources of supervision without requiring paired human-object-scene data. Experiments in complex indoor environments show that MAMHOI reduces object--scene penetration while better preserving human--object interaction quality, yielding more realistic and physically feasible scene-aware interactions. Project page: https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/
blocks.zh: 在复杂的3D场景中产生现实的人类-物体相互作用(HOI)需要两种互补能力:关于环境中相互作用可行性的推理和合成现实的人类-物体运动. 然而,对这些能力的监管很少能够大规模地联合提供。 人类空间数据集提供了丰富的环境感知运动信息,而人类物体数据集则捕捉到详细的相互作用动态,然而配对的人类空间数据仍然稀缺. 我们介绍MAMHOI, 一种承受得起的中介因素化 用于场景感知的人类物体交互生成。 MAMHOI通过场景理解与运动合成之间的明确运动-承受力接口,将场景-意识HOI生成要素化:场景-承受力模型首先预言了一种相互作用在何地和如何实际执行,而承担力-承受力-承受力的HOI模型然后产生相应的人-物体运动. 这种因子化使得场景理解和互动动态能够从互补的监督来源中学习,而不需要配对的人体-物体-场景数据. 在复杂的室内环境中进行的实验表明,MAMHOI减少了物体-场景穿透,同时更好地维护了人体-物体相互作用的质量,产生了更现实和物理上可行的场景-感知相互作用. 项目网页:https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/ https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/ 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2014-12-21.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Generating realistic human-object interactions (HOIs) in complex 3D environments requires more than synthesizing plausible human and object motion. The generated interaction must also adapt to the surrounding scene: the human must approach and manipulate the object without violating scene geometry, while the object must move through feasible regions and reach its intended target. Recent generative motion models have substantially improved the realism, diversity, and controllability of human motion and human-object interaction synthesis [ 20 , 2 , 1 , 29 , 11 , 6 ] . However, many of these models are developed in scene-free or simplified environments and therefore do not directly address how an interaction should adapt to complex scene geometry.
blocks.zh: 在复杂的三维环境中产生现实的人类-物体相互作用(HOIS),需要的不仅仅是合成假想的人类和物体运动. 所生成的相互作用也必须适应周围的场景:人类必须在不侵犯场景几何的情况下接近并操纵物体,而物体必须穿过可行的区域并达到预定目标. 最近的基因运动模型大大改善了人类运动和人与物体相互作用合成的现实主义,多样性和可控性[20,2,1,29,11,6]. 然而,这些模型中有许多是在无场景或简化的环境中开发的,因此没有直接涉及一种相互作用应如何适应复杂的场景几何.

blocks.en: Figure 1: MAMHOI learns from Scene-Free HOI priors and transfers the ability to complex environments through scene-aware motion affordances. This factorization enables physically plausible interactions across cluttered scenes and diverse objects.
blocks.zh: 图1:MAMHOI从"无场景HOI前传"中学习,并通过场景感知运动承受能力向复杂环境转移能力. 这种因子化使各种场景和各种物体在物理上可以进行可信的互动。

blocks.en: Scene-aware HOI generation requires two complementary capabilities. First, the model must reason about interaction feasibility : where and how an interaction can be executed given the scene layout, object location, and task objective. Second, it must model interaction dynamics : how the human and object should move together while maintaining realistic motion, contact, and manipulation behavior. Although these capabilities must ultimately operate together, supervision for them is rarely available jointly at scale. Human-scene datasets provide rich examples of environment-aware behavior [ 23 , 13 , 12 ] , while human-object datasets capture detailed synchronized interaction dynamics [ 15 , 26 ] . In contrast, collecting human-object-scene interactions that jointly cover diverse motions, objects, and scene geometries is substantially more difficult.
blocks.zh: 场景感知HOI生成需要两种互补能力. 首先,模型必须说明交互可行性:根据场景布局,对象位置,任务目标,可以在哪里以及如何执行交互. 第二,它必须模拟相互作用动态:人和物体应如何一起行动,同时保持现实的运动、接触和操纵行为。 虽然这些能力最终必须共同运作,但对它们的监督很少是规模化的。 人类-场景数据集提供了丰富的环境意识行为实例[23,13,12],而人类-对象数据集则捕捉了详细的同步相互作用动态[15,26]. 相比之下,收集共同覆盖不同运动、物体和场景地貌的人体-物体-场景相互作用则困难得多。

blocks.en: Existing methods bridge this gap in several ways. Some methods incorporate scene constraints through object waypoints, interaction anchors, or trajectory refinement [ 15 , 28 ] , while others construct synthetic scene-interaction pairs and directly train scene-conditioned generators [ 4 ] . Recent work further shows that human-object and human-scene data can be combined through hybrid training without requiring fully annotated human-object-scene interactions [ 31 ] . These approaches demonstrate the value of leveraging complementary data sources, but leave a fundamental modeling question open: how should scene-level interaction feasibility and detailed human-object dynamics be connected when their strongest supervision comes from different sources with distribution gap?
blocks.zh: 现有方法在若干方面弥补了这一差距。 有些方法通过物体的出行点,相互作用锚地,或轨迹的精细化[15,28]来纳入场景约束,而另一些方法则构造合成场景交互对并直接训练场景条件化的发电机[4]. 最近的工作还进一步表明,人类物体和人地数据可以通过混合训练加以合并,而不需要充分附加注释的人类物体-人地相互作用[31]. 这些方法表明了利用互补数据来源的价值,但留下一个基本的模型问题:当现场层面的互动可行性和详细的人-物体动力学最强的监督来自不同来源并存在分布差距时,如何将其联系起来?

blocks.en: We address this question by explicitly factorizing scene-aware HOI generation through an intermediate motion affordance . Rather than directly learning a single distribution over human motion, object manipulation, and scene geometry, Motion-Affordance-Mediated Human–Object Interaction (MAMHOI) separates scene understanding from human-object motion synthesis. The scene-understanding component predicts an affordance representation that captures task-relevant regions in which the interaction can be feasibly executed, while the motion generator synthesizes synchronized human-object motion conditioned on this representation. The affordance therefore serves as an explicit interface between the two capabilities: it communicates the scene-dependent constraints needed for interaction without prescribing the final human-object trajectory.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一种中间运动,明确将了解现场的HOI一代人考虑在内来解决这一问题。 与其直接学习人类运动、物体操纵和场景几何的单一分布,Motion-Afidance-Medified Human-Object Interactive(MAMHOI)将场景理解与人类-物体运动合成区分开来。 场景理解组件预言一种承受力表示,它能捕捉与任务相关的区域,其中可以实际执行交互,而运动发生器则会合成以这种表示为条件的同步人-物体运动. 因此,承受能力是两种能力之间的一个明确接口:它传达互动所需的视地限制,而不规定最后的人类物体轨迹。

blocks.en: Concretely, MAMHOI predicts motion affordance from scene geometry, object-motion cues, and language instructions, and converts the predicted affordance into local scene occupancy voxel grids around the human, object, and target region. These representations condition a diffusion-based human-object motion generator, allowing detailed interaction dynamics learned from motion-rich HOI data to adapt to complex environments. Planning is used only to provide coarse object-level structural cues rather than to determine the resulting human motion. This factorization allows scene reasoning and interaction synthesis to exploit complementary sources of supervision without requiring densely paired human-object-scene data.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,MAMHOI预测了场景几何、物体-运动提示和语言指示的可承受性,并将预测的可承受性转换成人类、物体和目标区域周围的局部场景占用网格。 这些表示条件是一个以扩散为基础的人-物体运动发生器,允许从运动丰富的HOI数据中吸取详细的相互作用动力学来适应复杂的环境. 规划仅用于提供粗糙的物体级结构提示,而并非用于确定所形成的人类运动. 这种因子化使场景推理和相互作用合成能够利用互补的监管来源而不需要密集配对的人类-物体-场景数据.

blocks.en: Experiments across interaction-only and scene-aware settings demonstrate the benefit of this formulation. MAMHOI preserves high-quality HOI dynamics while substantially improving scene compatibility, reducing penetrations without compromising object trajectory adherence.
blocks.zh: 跨越互动和场景感知环境的实验表明这种配方的好处。 MAMHOI保持了高品质的HOI动态,同时大幅度地提高了场景相容性,在不损害物体轨迹坚持性的情况下减少了穿透.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce MAMHOI , an affordance-mediated factorization of scene-aware HOI generation that separates scene-level interaction feasibility from detailed human-object motion synthesis, allowing the two capabilities to exploit complementary sources of supervision. • We formulate motion affordance as an explicit interface between scene reasoning and interaction synthesis, conveying task-relevant environmental constraints to the motion generator without restricting generation to a single prescribed trajectory. • We demonstrate that MAMHOI improves scene feasibility, particularly by reducing object–scene penetration, while preserving high-quality human–object interaction dynamics across complex indoor environments.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们引入了MAMHOI, 一种以承受力为媒介的场景感知HOI生成要素化, 将场景层面的相互作用可行性与详细的人-物体运动合成区分开来, 我们提出运动承受力,作为场景推理和相互作用综合之间的明确接口,向运动产生者传达与任务有关的环境限制,而不会将生成限制在单一规定的轨道上。 我们证明MAMHOI改善场景可行性,特别是通过减少物体-场景穿透,同时在复杂的室内环境中保持高质量的人-物体相互作用动力。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Human-Centric Motion Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 人类-儿童运动的产生

blocks.en:
Text-conditioned human motion generation aims to synthesize realistic motion from natural-language descriptions. Early methods use VAE- or GAN-based formulations, while recent diffusion and autoregressive models improve motion quality, diversity, and semantic alignment [ 7 , 18 , 8 , 20 , 2 , 30 , 1 , 29 , 11 , 6 ] . HOI generation extends this task by modeling human motion jointly with object manipulation, contact, and relative human-object movement [ 26 , 19 , 5 , 21 ] . Recent HOI methods incorporate explicit contact constraints, object affordances, relation-aware denoising, object geometry, and trajectory conditions to generate coordinated human-object motion [ 3 , 17 , 24 , 27 ] . In parallel, human-scene interaction (HSI) methods condition human motion on static scene geometry represented by point clouds, meshes, voxels, or egocentric features [ 9 , 23 , 13 , 12 ] .
Afford-Motion [ 22 ] further introduces scene affordance as an intermediate representation for language-guided HSI, defining it as a continuous distance field between human joints and 3D scene surfaces.
While sharing the idea of affordance-mediated generation, our motion affordance differs in both representation and role: it encodes the feasible spatial support of the joint human–object interaction rather than body–scene proximity, and serves to transfer scene-level feasibility to an HOI generator learned from scene-free human–object motion. Physics-based simulation and reinforcement learning have also been used to produce physically feasible interactions with static scene elements [ 10 , 25 ] . HOI methods generally emphasize manipulation in scene-free or simplified environments, whereas HSI methods primarily model human navigation and interaction with static scene elements.
blocks.zh:
以文字为条件的人类运动生成旨在从自然语言描述中合成现实的运动. 早期方法使用以VAE-或GAN为原料的配体,而最近的扩散和自递模型则会提高运动质量,多样性,以及语义相接[7,18,8,20,2,30,1,29,11,6]. HOI世代通过将人类运动与物体操纵,接触,以及相对的人类-物体运动相并用模型来延长这项任务[26,19,5,21]. 最近的HOI方法包括了明显的接触限制,物体承受力,关系意识去诺,物体几何,以及轨道条件,以产生协调的人体-物体运动[3,17,24,27]. 同时,人类-场景相互作用(HSI)方法将人类运动条件于以点云, meshes, voxels为代表的静态场景几何上,或以自负为中心特征[9,23,13,12].
Afford-Motion [22] 进一步引入了场景平价作为语言引导的HSI的中间代表,将其定义为人类关节和3D场景表面之间的连续距离场.
我们的动作承受力在代表性和作用上都有所不同:它编码了人类-物体联合相互作用而不是身体-场景相近的可行空间支持,并用于将场景层面的可行性转移到从无场景人类-物体运动中学到的HOI发电机上。 基于物理的模拟和强化学习也被用来产生物理上可行的与静态场景元素的相互作用[10,25]. HOI方法一般强调在无场景或简化的环境中进行操纵,而HSI方法则主要模拟人类导航和与静态场景元素的相互作用.

blocks.en: 2.2 Scene-Aware Human-Object Interaction Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 人与目标间互动

blocks.en: Recent methods have begun to address scene-aware human-object interaction generation. CHOIS [ 15 ] generates synchronized human-object motion from language, initial states, object geometry, and sparse object waypoints that can be provided by a high-level scene planner. Its scene constraints are therefore conveyed mainly through externally planned waypoints rather than an explicit representation of feasible interaction regions. HOSIG [ 28 ] decomposes the task into scene-aware grasp-pose generation, heuristic navigation, and scene-guided motion synthesis. However, both its interaction anchors and controllable motion generator rely on paired human-object-scene interaction data, and its released setup demonstrates only limited object coverage.
blocks.zh: 最近的方法已经开始处理场景感知到的人类物体交互生成. CHOIS [15]从语言,初始状态,物体几何,和由高阶场景规划师提供的稀有物体路由点产生同步的人类-物体运动. 因此,主要通过外部规划的路由点而不是明确反映可行的互动区域来表达其现场限制。 HOSIG [28] 将任务分解成场景感知到的可捉到的生成,热力导航,和场景导动合成. 然而,它的相互作用锚地和可控运动发生器都依赖于配对的人体-物体-场地相互作用数据,其所释放的设置仅显示有限的物体覆盖.

blocks.en: Another line of work addresses the scarcity of paired interaction-scene data through data augmentation. UniHM [ 4 ] constructs synthetic scene-motion pairs by placing existing motions into collision-free regions of indoor scenes and trains a unified scene-conditioned generator on the resulting data. Such augmentation primarily encourages the model to identify feasible regions in which a motion can be executed, while its waypoint conditioning does not guarantee exact object trajectory adherence. InfBaGel [ 31 ] further combines synthesized human-object-scene interactions with real human-scene interaction data through hybrid training. While this improves scene feasibility, jointly learning from heterogeneous motion distributions introduces a trade-off between scene-level physical feasibility and preserving task-specific human-object interaction priors.
blocks.zh: 另一行工作是通过数据扩充,解决对等互动-场面数据的稀缺问题。 UniHM [4]通过将已存在的运动放入室内场景的无相撞区域来构建合成场景-运动对,并在由此产生的数据上培训一个统一的场景条件生成器. 这种增强主要鼓励该模型确定可以执行运动的可行区域,而其路由条件不能保证准确的物体轨迹。 InfBaGel [31]通过混合训练,进一步将合成的人体-物体-场面相互作用与真实的人体-场面相互作用数据结合. 虽然这提高了场景可行性,但共同从不同的运动分布中学习,在场景层面的物理可行性与保留特定任务的人与对象交互前作之间引入了取舍.

blocks.en: Our method instead avoids constructing or jointly fitting heterogeneous paired human-object-scene data. We represent scene constraints through motion affordance and learn scene feasibility separately from human-object motion, allowing scene knowledge to guide where interactions are feasible while preserving the interaction distribution learned from dedicated human-object data.
blocks.zh: 相反,我们的方法避免了构建或联合安装各种对等的人类物体场地数据。 我们通过运动承受力和学习场景可行性与人类物体运动分开来代表场景限制,使场景知识能够指导那些可以进行互动的地方,同时保留从人类物体专用数据中吸取的相互作用分布.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Overview of MAMHOI. (A) The scene-understanding module predicts a task-specific affordance from the scene, planned object path, and instruction, where the instruction guides the task-relevant human placement along the object path. (B) The affordance interface lifts the predicted affordance to 3D and queries local occupancy around the pelvis, object, and goal position of current segment, and encodes them into affordance features through a ViT-based Affordance-voxel encoder. (C) The resulting affordance features condition segment-wise HOI generation through cross-attention, with each generated segment initializing the next.
Through this design, scene-aware HOI generation is factorized into a scene-to-affordance factor learned from indoor HSI data and an affordance-to-motion factor learned from scene-free HOI data.
blocks.zh:
图2:MAMHOI概况. (A)场景理解模块预测从场景,计划对象路径,以及指令中,该指令引导与任务相关的人类沿着对象路径进行布置任务所对应的承受能力. (B)平价接口将预计的平价提升至3D,并询问当前地段的骨盆,物体和目标位置周围的局部占用情况,并通过基于ViT的平价-voxel编码器将它们编码为平价特征. (C) 由此产生的负担性特性通过交叉意向分层生成HOI,每个分层启动分层。

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价设置

blocks.en: We train the two components of MAMHOI on complementary datasets: the scene understanding model is trained on LINGO [ 12 ] , while the human–object motion backbone is trained on OMOMO [ 16 ] . Affordance supervision for both components is constructed using relaxed axis-aligned bounding-box (AABB) regions around the corresponding motion trajectories, providing a common spatial representation across the two data sources.
blocks.zh: 我们对MAMHOI的两个组件进行补充数据集培训:场景理解模型在LINGO[12]上进行训练,而人-物体运动主干则在OMOMO[16]上进行训练. 对两个部件的承受能力监督是通过围绕相应运动轨迹的松动轴相接-框(ABB)区域构建的,提供了两个数据来源之间的共同空间代表.

blocks.en: For interaction-only evaluation, we use the OMOMO validation split, which contains 534 paired human–object motion sequences of 120 frames, covering 12 movable objects and 2 unseen subjects. With scene absent, this setting evaluates intrinsic interaction quality, including motion distribution, text–motion alignment, and diversity against paired ground truth.
blocks.zh: 仅用于交互评价,我们使用OMOMO验证分法,包含534对120帧的人体-物体运动序列,涵盖12个可移动物体和2个不见对象。 在没有场景的情况下,这个设定评价了内在的相互作用质量,包括运动分布、文本 - 运动相接以及多样性与对地真理相匹配。

blocks.en: For scene-aware evaluation, we construct a physical test set from static scenes in the LINGO test split, where paired ground-truth human–object motion is unavailable. We manually specify feasible start–goal configurations and use A* planning to generate 164 unique object paths from 20 test scenes. Evaluating five movable objects per path yields about 820 trials, which are used to assess physical feasibility such as contact and penetrations.
blocks.zh: 在LINGO试验分出时, 我们用静态场景构建一套物理测试, 我们手动指定可行的起始目标配置, 并使用 A* 计划从 20 个测试场景生成 164 个独特的对象路径 。 每条路径对5个可移动物体进行评价,产生大约820个试验,用于评估接触和穿透等物理可行性.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented MAMHOI, an affordance-mediated factorization for scene-aware human-object interaction generation that separates scene-level interaction feasibility from detailed human-object motion synthesis. By using motion affordance as an explicit interface between scene reasoning and motion generation, MAMHOI allows these complementary capabilities to be learned from different sources of supervision without requiring paired human-object-scene data. Experiments in complex indoor environments show that this formulation improves scene feasibility, particularly by reducing object–scene penetration, while preserving high-quality human–object interaction dynamics, enabling more realistic and physically feasible scene-aware interactions.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了MAMHOI,一种可负担的、由中介的因子化,用于场景感知的人类物体相互作用生成,将场景层面相互作用的可行性与详细的人类物体运动合成区分开来. 通过将运动承受力作为场景推理和运动产生之间的明确接口,MAMHOI允许这些互补能力从不同的监督来源中学习,而不需要配对的人体-物体-场景数据. 在复杂的室内环境中进行的实验表明,这种配方提高了场景可行性,特别是通过减少物体-场景穿透,同时保持高质量的人-物体相互作用动态,从而能够进行更现实和更实际可行的场景-感知相互作用。

blocks.en:
The scene-understanding component is trained on LINGO [ 12 ] ,
which provides human motion in complex indoor environments together
with scene geometry and language descriptions.
Following the formulation in the main paper, we construct a
sequence-level motion affordance from each scene-aware motion
sequence using relaxed axis-aligned spatial support covering the
observed interaction region.
The corresponding scene geometry is represented in the horizontal
scene coordinate system, while an object-level path provides coarse
navigation structure for affordance prediction.
The scene-understanding model therefore learns to predict feasible
interaction support from the scene, planned path, and language
instruction without requiring paired human–object manipulation data.

blocks.en:
Canonicalizing the local scene voxels to the human orientation consistently
improves performance over keeping them aligned with the scene coordinate
frame.
Without test-time guidance, the human-aligned representation improves all
reported metrics, with particularly large reductions in human-scene
penetration and motion jerk.
This suggests that expressing nearby geometry in a human-centric coordinate
frame provides a more consistent spatial reference for learning the mapping
between scene context and interaction motion, rather than requiring the model
to account for arbitrary global scene orientations.
Test-time SDF guidance is complementary to this representation, further
reducing human-scene penetration and improving the contact ratio.
The guided human-aligned model achieves the strongest human-scene results,
while the unguided variant retains slightly better performance on several
object-scene and human-object penetration metrics.

blocks.en:
We additionally evaluate our method on a TRUMANS-based setting to enable
comparison with HOSIG [ 28 ] .
Unlike our primary evaluation protocol, TRUMANS inherently contains paired
human motion and scene context.
Consequently, the motion distribution itself may already encode scene-specific
biases, introducing scene–motion distribution leakage that does not strictly
match our intended setting, where scene understanding and human–object
interaction priors are learned from separate sources.
We therefore treat this experiment as an auxiliary evaluation rather than part
of our main benchmark.
Its purpose is to examine whether the proposed factorization preserves the
information carried by both factors when trained and evaluated on a dataset
where scene and motion distributions are already correlated.

This evaluation is substantially smaller than our primary benchmark.
In particular, HOSIG has a comparatively expensive inference pipeline, making
large-scale evaluation impractical under the same setting.
We therefore retain the original HOSIG test split and report the results as a

blocks.en:
We conduct a two-alternative forced-choice (2AFC) perceptual study to complement the geometry-based evaluation in the main paper.
The study evaluates whether generated human–object interactions appear physically plausible and natural in complex indoor scenes.
blocks.zh:
我们进行了一项两起强制选择(2AFC)概念研究,以补充主要文件中的几何学评价。
这项研究评价了在复杂的室内场景中产生的人-物体相互作用在物理上是否合理和自然。

blocks.en:
We construct 136 pairwise comparisons from the scene-aware test set.
Each comparison presents two motion sequences generated under the same task and scene configuration.
The comparison pool contains four method pairings:
Ours vs. CHOIS,
Ours + SDF guidance vs. CHOIS + SDF guidance,
Ours vs. CHOIS + SDF guidance, and
Ours + SDF guidance vs. CHOIS.
The 136 comparisons are divided into eight tracks, each containing 17 trials, to limit the workload of each individual response.
blocks.zh:
我们从场景感知测试中构建了136个对比比较.
每次比较都呈现出在同一任务和场景配置下产生的两个运动序列.
比较池包含四个方法配对:
我们对崔斯
我们的+SDF指导对CHOIS+SDF指导,
我们对崔斯+SDF指导,以及
我们的+SDF指导对CHOIS.
136项比较分为8个轨道,每个轨道包含17项审判,以限制每项答复的工作量。

blocks.en:
For each trial, participants view the two generated sequences side by side and answer: “Which interaction looks more physically plausible and natural in the given scene?” Participants select either the left or right sequence.
Method identities are not shown during evaluation.
blocks.zh:
对于每次试验,参与者都一并查看两个生成的序列,并回答:“在给定的场景中,哪一种互动看起来更具有物理可行性和自然性?” 参与者选择左右顺序.
在评价期间不显示方法身份。

blocks.en:
The order of trials within each track is randomized, and the left–right placement of the compared methods is independently randomized for each trial.
Both sequences in a comparison use the same rendering configuration and character colors, such that visual appearance does not reveal the underlying method.
These choices reduce potential ordering, side-selection, and rendering biases.
blocks.zh:
每一轨道内的审判顺序是随机的,比较方法的左-右位置是独立随机的。
在比较中两个序列都使用相同的渲染配置和字符颜色,因此视觉外观不会揭示出基础方法.
这些选择减少了潜在的命令、附带选择和偏见。

blocks.en:
Approximately 48 participants were recruited through Prolific and in-person recruitment.
Some participants completed more than one track, resulting in 52 completed track-level responses in total.
Since each response contains 17 pairwise trials, we collect 884 valid pairwise judgments.
Participation was voluntary, and the collected responses are used only for research purposes and reported in aggregate.
blocks.zh:
大约48名学员是通过Prolific和当面招聘的。
一些参与者完成了不止一个赛道,共完成52个赛道级响应.
由于每项答复都包含17项对等审判,我们收集了884项有效的对等判决。
参与是自愿的,所收集的答复仅用于研究目的并汇总报告。
